name: USPP025358P3
description: United States plant patent US PP25,358, granted 17 March 2015 to inventor Kanachana Khemakongkanond for an Aglaonema plant named 'KKAG201303'. This record exists solely to document a correction: this patent number has been circulated as the patent for the blueberry selection 'EB 9-12' (OZblu Bonita). It is not a blueberry patent. The correct patent for 'EB 9-12' is US PP28,358.

attributes.correction_note: Frequently mis-cited as the patent for blueberry 'EB 9-12'. The correct blueberry patent is US PP28,358.
